name: Lower back relief
description: Gentle movement and support work for a stiff lower back. Stay in a pain-free range, and see a professional if pain is sharp or spreads down a leg.

items.cue: Small rocks of the pelvis, flatten then lift the low back.
Hug the knee in, other leg relaxed.
Let the knee fall across, shoulders stay down.
Draw the knee toward the opposite shoulder.
Slow and small, only the range that feels good.
Knees wide, sink back and breathe into the low back.
Rest on the forearms, glutes relaxed.
Reach long, hips level, alternate sides slowly.
Squeeze the glutes, ribs down, no arching.
Tuck the pelvis to feel the front of the hip.
Let the back rest flat and breathe.
